name: sijilat
description: Search Bahrain's Sijilat commercial registry and get business and owner phone numbers.
long_description: Searches the Sijilat commercial registry by name, activity (ISIC4 code or keyword), municipality, block or company type, and returns contacts: business phone, mobile, fax, email, website, address, plus the owner's phone from the CR's latest GET LICENSE application. Phones are normalised to E.164. No API key needed.

tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Search the registry by name, activity, municipality, block, type or CR number.

tools.name: get_business_contacts
tools.description: Phone, mobile, email, address and owner contact for one CR/branch.

tools.name: find_business_phones
tools.description: Search and return contacts for each match in one call.

tools.name: search_activities
tools.description: Look up ISIC4 activity codes for a keyword.
